items.title: Intuit Selling Mailchimp for $3.68 Billion to Berkshire Hathaway-Backed Bending Spoons
items.why: Intuit is selling Mailchimp to Bending Spoons, a Berkshire Hathaway-backed company, for $3.68 billion.
